name: Golden Eagle Woodwork LLC
old_description: Golden Eagle Woodwork began with a vision to provide high quality craftsmanship and satisfaction to its customers. That continues to be the owner's focus today. The owner, Jaime Vazquez, began his career installing interior trim in the high-end custom homes of the ski resort slopes in Vail and Beaver Creek in Colorado. In the early 2000's, Jaime moved to our beloved Montana and continued with the same drive and vision to provide the custom homes in Big Sky with a quality product that exceeds the customer's expectations.
about:
Golden Eagle Woodwork LLC is based in Bozeman, Montana. The company was founded by Jaime Vazquez, who began his career installing interior trim in high-end custom homes in Vail and Beaver Creek, Colorado, before relocating to Montana in the early 2000s to serve the Big Sky area.

The shop operates as a custom wood shop providing full trim packages, custom cabinet builds, custom built-ins, door and hardware installation, interior casework, and wood wall and ceiling paneling. It also handles remodels and custom builds for both residential and commercial projects. Since 2019, the company has actively expanded its contractor network in the Bozeman and Big Sky area.

Golden Eagle Woodwork primarily serves contractors and homeowners in the Bozeman and Big Sky region. Its client base includes general contractors seeking interior trim carpentry for custom homes and commercial remodels.

The company emphasizes high-quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction as its founding vision. Owner Jaime Vazquez, though no longer on the tools, continues to drive the focus on detail and care in every project, from base and case to tongue-and-groove wood ceilings.
